description: The changes of one builder app as a chat: the first generation, every change request (an AI edit, status QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED or FAILED with the error; credits used, refunded = true when it failed and the credits came back) and every undo, oldest first. Each message has the version it made: number, current, the version it was made from, files changed, lines added and removed. undo = the version an undo of the current version goes back to (or null). With version (a version id from a message): the file diff of that version against the version it was made from, per file (added, removed or changed; hunks of lines with t "+" added, "-" removed, " " context; truncated = more changes than shown). Read only. Every plan with an account.

version.description: Version id from a message (optional): returns its file diff

name: builder_changes
title: App builder changes and diffs
